hero.headline: Turn the English you know into English you can actually use
hero.sub: HiFive English's 1:1 video English class gives you 25 minutes to say the sentences you've learned out loud — and get corrected on the spot. It's not about memorizing more grammar; it's about building the instinct to actually speak English.

output.title: Why "1:1" video English, not just "video English"
output.lead: Listening more won't make you fluent. Only time spent actually speaking will.
output.body: For students learning English in an EFL environment like Korea — where there's little chance to use English in daily life — what's missing isn't vocabulary or grammar knowledge. It's time spent actually putting that knowledge into words out loud.

left.label: Group Classes
points: Each student's speaking time is limited
Time spent waiting for other students' turns

right.label: 1:1 Video English
points: 25 or 50 minutes dedicated to just one student
Far more speaking practice and corrections overall

output.highlight: A 25-minute class = 25 minutes that are entirely yours to speak
output.closing: And it's not a class that just marches through a fixed syllabus. When a student's sentence sounds unnatural, the tutor rephrases it more naturally right then and there, and the student says it again using that new phrasing. Repeating this cycle throughout the class turns expressions you merely "know" into expressions you can actually "use."

ai.title: What AI English apps can't give you
ai.lead: AI can hold a conversation. What it can't do is understand you.
ai.body: AI chatbots and English learning apps can seem to hold fairly natural conversations within their set patterns. But they can't pick up on unexpected questions, jokes that go off-script, or the fact that you're just having an off day and the words aren't coming out.
ai.body2: A human tutor is different. They talk with you to figure out where you hesitate, why you keep making the same mistakes, and why you seem more nervous than usual today — then adjust the difficulty and style of their questions on the spot.

left.label: AI Learning Apps
points: Flags errors mechanically, the same way every time
Has no sense of how you're feeling or your condition that day

right.label: HiFive Tutors
points: Handles unexpected questions and situations naturally
Adjusts approach based on your personality and how you're doing that day
Understands you more deeply with every class

ai.highlight: AI can be a conversation partner — but it can't be a teacher who truly understands you.

strengths.title: 12 years of refined standards, tuition without the markup
strengths.body: For 12 years, we've continually refined how we select, train, and evaluate our tutors. Only tutors who meet that bar teach our classes, and we cut out costs that have nothing to do with the quality of the class itself, investing that instead in the classes you actually get. We don't believe expensive means better — but we don't aim for cheap for its own sake either.

strengths.title: An unbroken path from practical basics to advanced English
strengths.body: From toddlers just starting with the alphabet and phonics, to middle and high schoolers looking to go beyond school English, to adults who need English for work and travel right now — we build a solid foundation in practical English first, then design each stage to lead naturally into more advanced, academic English.

feedbackStrength.title: Feedback that doesn't end when class does
feedbackStrength.body: A one-line comment like "Great class today" doesn't really help parents understand what happened in their child's lesson. That's why we're building a system — targeted for launch in late 2026 — that analyzes the entire class from start to finish and delivers far more specific feedback.
items: What the student is doing well
What to focus on next class
feedbackStrength.closing: Our goal is simple: even without sitting in on the class, you'll know exactly what your child did today — and what they should practice next.

closingCta.title: See for yourself — it only takes 25 minutes
closingCta.body: Nothing explains it better than experiencing it yourself. Try a free level test and see what a HiFive English class is really like.
